description: This file defines API routes related to user notifications for Travel Planner Pro, including listing notifications, marking individual notifications as read, and marking all notifications as read. It uses FastAPI router, interacts with database models, and converts ORM objects to schema response objects.

methods.name: NotificationResponse _notification_to_response(n: Notification)
methods.description: Converts a Notification ORM object to a NotificationResponse schema, mapping notification types to frontend types.

methods.name: list_notifications( current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: API endpoint to list all notifications for the current user, ordered recent first.

methods.name: mark_notification_read( notification_id: str, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: API endpoint to mark a specific notification as read based on its ID.

methods.name: mark_all_notifications_read( current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: API endpoint to mark all notifications for the current user as read.
